title: A Once in a Lifetime Financial Reset is Coming. (Why Stocks Are Next)
speaker: Tom Nash

macro_themes.theme: Crash risk from geopolitics and rates
macro_themes.view: Iran, Ukraine, Fed hikes and oil near $100 are real risks that could easily cause a 20-30% S&P drop.

macro_themes.theme: Wars don't break markets long term
macro_themes.view: No war has ever brought down the S&P 500; past oil shocks were followed by large multi-year gains.
Stay invested, dollar-cost average and double down on drawdowns rather than going to cash.

calls.condition: Double down if S&P falls 10% (or stocks fall 20%).
calls.reason: Historical recovery after oil/war shocks, 75% of years and 100% of 20-year periods positive; S&P core holding via DCA.
calls.quote: no war in history has ever brought down the S&P 500. That's a fact.

notes: Educational investing video, no specific levels or near-term direction; host says a 20-30% S&P drop 'can easily happen' but explicitly refuses to predict timing, so short/medium bias set to none. Palantir used only as an example (near $200, beta 3). video_type 'daily_market' is the closest fit; it is not really a daily recap.
